4.1 Obligation. Each Party shall keep the other Party's Confidential Information strictly confidential and shall not disclose it to any third party without prior written consent.
5.1 Limitation. Neither Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall exceed the total fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim.
